text:
Aydar Suniev is a third-round pick (80th in 2023) who has quietly become a useful NHL forward for Calgary. The former UMass winger has four goals and six points in 15 games, at about 13 minutes a night, and he's been on the right side of a lot of close games: our wins-added measure has him ranked 120th of 512 skaters, mostly from goals that swung results.

The finishing is running hot. Four goals on 2.73 expected and an 18.2% shooting rate are above what we'd expect to last, though his shot is a real weapon (80th percentile by NHL Edge). The rest evens out: the Flames have scored a bit less than expected with him on the ice, and they play him to about a break-even share of the chances at five on five, slightly better than the team without him. Flames Nation has been tracking how he and Jonathan Castagna have fit after their first dozen games, and the answer so far is well. His ice time is down about a minute over his last ten games, so watch whether that holds. Our middle projection is around 17 goals.
